Name: Walk to the Desert from Additional area
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][size=5][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the entrustment of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color]

[color=#ff0000]从额外地区走向沙漠[/color]
[color=#ff0000]Walk to the Desert from Additional Area[/color]
[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4]另一个走向沙漠的mod，它的入口在[/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12838]星露谷物语额外区域[/url] 的垂钓池塘边，如果你没有安装[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12838]星露谷物语额外区域[/url] ，那入口就会移动到边远森林，新增了6张地图，有觅食，有树木可以砍伐，还有一个无限怪物的山洞，准备好了再进去，否则有可能躺着出来。还有，你需要解锁沙漠地图才可以前往沙漠，也可以通过修改配置文件提前进入沙漠。
Another mod that goes to the desert, it is by the fishing pond from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12838]Stardew Valley Additional Areas[/url]﻿. If you do not install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12838]Stardew Valley Additional Areas[/url]﻿ mod, the entrance will move to the backwoods, 6 new maps are added, with foraging, trees to cut down, and a cave of infinite monsters. Be prepared for the cave, or risk being knocked unconscious. Also, you need to unlock the desert area to go to the desert, You can also modify the config file to enter the desert in advance.
[/size][/color]

[color=#ff0000][size=4]关于兼容性：
Compatibility:

几乎兼容所有主流mod，包括SVE，RSV等，它也兼容﻿走向沙漠（Walk to the Desert）
Compatible with almost all mainstream mods, including SVE, RSV, etc. It is also compatible with Walk to the Desert[/size][/color]

If you like my mod, can you [url=https://ko-fi.com/liunianhui]buy me a cup of coffee[/url]﻿﻿?[/size][/color][/center]
